rows.name: Operation of police powers under TACT 2000, to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Arrest, outcome and stop-and-search statistics under terrorism legislation are aggregate legal-process data and do not predict a terrorist incident, person, building or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The accredited official release covers arrests, outcomes, court proceedings, prisoners and stop-and-search powers up to 31 March 2026.

rows.name: Football-related arrests and banning orders: 2025 to 2026 domestic season
rows.semantic_limit: Match, club and season statistics describe reported incidents and police actions; they cannot establish current risk at a stadium, route, supporter or nearby parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official release covers arrests, banning orders, reported incidents and online hate or abuse connected to regulated football matches.

rows.name: Crime outcomes in England and Wales, 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Outcome proportions reflect recorded-offence processing and must not be interpreted as the probability of detection, prosecution or safety for an individual incident or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official release describes outcomes assigned to recorded offences by outcome and offence type, including knife and firearm-related offences.

rows.name: UK Government Resilience Action Plan: 2026 Implementation Report
rows.semantic_limit: Policy objectives, delivery actions and system reforms are resilience-governance context, not measurements of local hazard exposure or exact-parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: The official implementation report describes risk assessment, public preparedness and public-sector resilience actions.

rows.name: Emergency department syndromic surveillance weekly bulletins 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Anonymised syndromic trends are population-surveillance signals and cannot diagnose an individual or establish illness burden at a specific hospital catchment, address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official weekly series publishes daily emergency-department attendance trends, with week 29 data available on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: National ambulance syndromic surveillance weekly bulletins 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Anonymised ambulance-call syndromic trends are broad public-health signals and cannot establish emergency demand, diagnosis or risk at an exact address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official weekly series publishes daily ambulance-call trends, with week 29 data available on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: Policing statistics current release index
rows.semantic_limit: A collection index verifies release identity and chronology only; it is not independent evidence of crime, police performance or local parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: The official collection indexes current police workforce, TACT, football, firearms, licensing, custody and other policing statistical releases.
